reference.use: Our own first film of the topic, picture and sound approved by the owner (2026-11-13). The owner asked us to make the reference ourselves: "you are the one making that reference!". Build like it. Never retell it.

origin.note: The owner: "its a story just like the InThisTown it has the same camera technique". The numbers in `film` and `sound` were first borrowed from In This Town's one-to-two-minute short cut. The reference film was built to them and sits inside every one, so none had to change: `measuredFromReference` says where in each range it landed. Only the opening ("What if") and the beat sheet in SCRIPT.md are this topic's own. The `long` cut is still In This Town's three-minute film and has not been built in this topic.

film.opensWithHint: A "What if" that is answered with facts and not with a story is an explainer: use --topic explainer.

models.note: Finished films the owner approved, to build like. The first is the topic's reference film. Each is kept with its source in Topics/WhatIf/reference (README.md there lists them). Copy how they are built; never copy their story.
